title: Take-Two Enhances Defenses Against GTA 6 AI Reverse-Engineering
description: Ahead of the launch of GTA 6, Rockstar parent company Take-Two responds to AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation threats.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two Steps Up Technical Defenses Against GTA 6 AI Reverse-Engineering Threats

As the highly anticipated launch of *GTA 6* approaches, the security surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster is under intense scrutiny. According to a recent report by IGN Games, the head of Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two, has addressed the growing threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and game decompilation, confirming that the company is actively enhancing its technical defenses and legal measures.

### Protecting Core Assets in the Age of AI

The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence has introduced new challenges for the video game industry. While AI tools offer various development advantages, they can also potentially be leveraged for malicious reverse-engineering and decompilation of complex software. For a massive release like *GTA 6*, safeguarding proprietary code and intellectual property is of the utmost importance. By reinforcing technical barriers and preparing legal activities, Take-Two aims to mitigate risks associated with code leakage and unauthorized modifications ahead of the game's release.

### Editor's Take

As AI technology continues to advance, the methods used to target video games are inevitably evolving as well. Take-Two's proactive stance in enhancing both technical and legal defenses highlights the modern challenges publishers face in protecting massive entertainment properties. It is a necessary step to ensure the integrity of a game like *GTA 6* upon launch.
